This accesses the Azure AI project safety evaluations back-end service, which provisions a GPT model specific to harms evaluation that can generate content risk severity scores and reasoning to enable the safety evaluators.

  8. Single-Turn Evaluation — analize query/reponse pairs
  9. Code-Based Evaluators: use Python functions or callable classes to define specific evaluation metrics, such as calculating response length. — Prompt-Based Evaluators: create AI-assisted evaluators using Prompty files, leveraging customizable prompt templates for enhanced assessment.
  10. Slide 90
  11. Slide 91
  12. Slide 92
  13. The target is the AI system you want to probe for safety risks. Four types of target are supported: — Model configurations — Simple callbacks — Advanced callbacks — PyRIT prompt targets
  14. There are default grouped attack strategies — Easy: Base64, Flip, Morse — Moderate: Tense — Difficult: Tense + Base64 (composite)
  15. Attack strategies are methods to take the baseline direct adversarial queries and convert them into another form to try bypassing your target's safeguards.
  16. It is possible to compose multiple attack strategies into a single attack
